moments.text: IR view with a magenta crosshair over streaky grey sea; a tiny white speck sits just below right of the crosshair.
The speck drifts right of the crosshair, then climbs steadily toward the top, leaving at the top edge by the black box at 18.3 s.
Black, grey and white frames flash around a rectangular inset as the sensor changes zoom (~0.7 s).
Wider view: bright streaky water at the top fading to dark below; the centre inset glitches again near 34.3 s. No object in view.
